info.title: NarcoScope Public Evidence API
info.description: Read-only access to NarcoScope's aggregate official-data overview, country-year illicit-economy atlas, privacy-minimized public designations, citation-gated newsroom, and non-joinable Seiche and Palimpsest context lanes. No endpoint provides point-of-sale, real-time, navigable, synthesis-route, or yield information; no federation endpoint creates a shared score, composite, causal inference, or culpability inference.

PalimpsestBriSuccess.description: Verified BRI response envelope whose data is the exact packaged artifact value

FederationSuccess.description: Separate Seiche and Palimpsest evidence lanes

Unavailable.description: Typed unavailable evidence; absence is not zero coverage

get.summary: Discover product capabilities, access points, audiences, and safety boundaries
Read bounded headline aggregates from the bundled official datasets
List deterministic analyses and their publication-gate receipts
Read one newsroom story as metadata, machine brief, or cited dossier
Read the official-only China aggregate and its claim boundaries
Read official country aggregates for China, Pakistan, and Myanmar under a geography-and-time-only join contract
Read pinned BRI source readiness and national economic coverage as a parallel, non-joinable context lane
get.description: Returns CPEC, Gwadar, CMEC, Kyaukpyu, and Balochistan target readiness plus World Bank WDI country-indicator-year coverage counts. Drug-conflict-infrastructure causal joins, actor classification, bilateral route inference, guilt, political-movement classification, project attribution from national series, and tactical or navigable use are prohibited.

500.description: The packaged artifact, sidecar, schema, or semantic boundary failed closed

get.summary: Page country-year organized-crime and firearms-tracing observations
get.description: Returns the two source-native domains as separate records with their original metadata, per-record availability, caveats, and null-versus-zero distinction intact. The API never combines the domains into a shared score.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Opaque stable keyset cursor bound to the complete filter set.

get.summary: Page privacy-minimized public OFAC designation identities
get.description: Returns only stable public entity number, official name, entity type, programs, and countries. Aliases and subject-level sensitive fields are withheld. A designation is an administrative action, not proof of guilt or an adjudication.

parameters.name: country
parameters.description: Exact country label after case-insensitive normalization.

parameters.name: query
parameters.description: Case-insensitive substring search over official names only; aliases are neither searched nor returned.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Opaque stable keyset cursor bound to the complete filter set.

get.summary: Read separate Seiche and Palimpsest public evidence lanes
get.description: Fetches selected public Seiche world-market sections or its global money atlas with one GET, a 15-second whole-response deadline, a 2,000,000-byte ceiling, and zero retries. Palimpsest BRI and the pinned historical newswire-rights receipt remain separate lanes. Values are never joined, averaged into a composite, or used to infer causality or culpability.
